source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) published rates and plan-design rules

Original Medicare (Part A + B).monthly_premium: $0 Part A (if 40+ work quarters) + ~$206 Part B
Original Medicare (Part A + B).annual_deductible: $1,676 Part A per benefit period + ~$283 Part B
Original Medicare (Part A + B).coverage_highlights: Any doctor/hospital that accepts Medicare; no networks
Original Medicare (Part A + B).best_for: People who want provider freedom and travel often

Medicare Advantage (Part C).monthly_premium: $0-$70 (many plans $0, plus you still pay Part B)
Medicare Advantage (Part C).coverage_highlights: Bundles A, B, usually D, plus dental/vision/hearing extras; network-based
Medicare Advantage (Part C).best_for: Lower monthly cost and extra benefits, if you stay in-network

Medigap (Supplement Plan G).max_out_of_pocket: Effectively the Part B deductible for covered services
Medigap (Supplement Plan G).coverage_highlights: Pays most out-of-pocket costs Original Medicare leaves; any Medicare provider
Medigap (Supplement Plan G).best_for: Predictable costs and minimal surprise bills

Part D (Prescription Drug).max_out_of_pocket: $2,100 true out-of-pocket cap on covered drugs (2026)
Part D (Prescription Drug).coverage_highlights: Standalone drug coverage; formularies and tiers vary by plan
Part D (Prescription Drug).best_for: Anyone on Original Medicare who takes prescriptions
